note: SA-1B/LAION-vs-test-set contamination forensics with memorization-signal stratification; NLP contamination studies provide the template, dense prediction lacks the audit. Closed-corpus bounds honesty (own note) is right. Lit-attacked below.

Benchmark-repair-and-rerank has landed for COCO (refined-mask re-annotation line, ECCV 2024 era); the surviving delta is multi-benchmark scope plus the 'errors favor style-matched models' asymmetry claim, which is genuinely new.

COCO mask coarseness and its consequences are now documented by refined re-annotation efforts; the surviving sliver (straight-segment mimicry in model outputs) should migrate into 0312's style-dialect paper.

Semantic-versioning debt (phantom progress from definition drift and preprocessing forks) is a real hygiene finding; the labor is archaeological rather than computational, and the most-cited-chains prioritization makes it tractable.

A published per-benchmark headroom table (model-fixable vs reference noise) would redirect where the field reports results - it even makes a testable sociological prediction; assumption-dependence is handled by reporting ranges.

Intra-set duplication audits have classification precedents (CIFAR/ImageNet dup studies); the dense-task version with topical-weighting framing is a solid, cheap contribution that folds naturally into 0301's contamination program.

Geographic performance gradients are established for recognition (Dollar-Street line); the dense-prediction version with boundary-quality gradients and corpus-representation regression is the open slice, and requires funding geo-diverse mask annotation.

Dual-capture rigs give the sensor-gap question clean causal data, and the sensor-simulation recovery leg makes it constructive; three sensor types (own note) is the minimum for the claim to generalize.

'PQ's matching cliff has been manufacturing significance' is a precise, hours-cheap jitter analysis with a constructive smooth variant; the diagnostic-first positioning defuses adoption-inertia objections.

The Recht-style fresh-test-set replication that dense prediction has borrowed its confidence from but never run; protocol-faithful collection is the crux and the entire cost. High field value either way it comes out.

Difficulty drift and the timeless-hard core are cheap to measure from the public model zoo and useful for curators; the finding is descriptive, and its best use is as the empirical base for 0305's headroom logic.

'Labels are dialects and models learn the dialect' unifies the 0156/0224/0303 forensic threads into the strongest single formulation, with the style-vs-content gap decomposition as the headline; shared-class matched-size controls answer the confound.

The metric-learning-reality-check playbook applied to segmentation SOTA claims; released-checkpoint restriction keeps it feasible, and the >30% within-noise prediction is concrete enough to be falsified. Norms-changing potential.

Keyframe selection bias (benchmarks skip blur and transitions) is a sharp optimism-gap claim; the interpolated-GT evaluation of hard frames is the soft joint (own note) and conservative gating plus human spot checks must carry it.

Ecosystem-scale patient-leakage forensics via anatomical fingerprinting is a hygiene audit with clinical-claims consequences; individual incidents are known, the systematic scan is not. Matcher validation on ID-known data is the required control.

Negative-set poverty explains the notorious benchmark-to-deployment FPR chasm for smoke/fire; the deployment-FPR validation needs an operator partnership (own note), without which the orders-of-magnitude claim stays projected. Merge candidate with 0090/0076 program.

Background-memorization vs necessary background-dependence is a smart distinction for transparency datasets; re-rendering refraction for background swaps (own note) is technically serious, capture-based swaps limit scale.

'Graded on portfolio shots, deployed on security-camera reality' is a quotable thesis; the aesthetics-difficulty entanglement (own admission: covariate design is the whole game) is where this lives or dies.

Recovering annotation zoom levels forensically from mask geometry is an original instrument supporting 0150's scale-relativity thesis; per-mask recovery may be too noisy (own note), making dataset-level distributions the honest deliverable.

Within-dataset ontology inconsistency mined from near-duplicate pairs with conflicting labels is a clean instrument; class-merged re-evaluation quantifies how much 'confusion' is actually reference noise. Solid, competes with 0302/0305 for the same reform slot.

'Rare-class science runs below its own noise floor' - bootstrap CIs on LVIS rare classes plus the unverified-negative bias measurement is nearly-free statistics with direct consequences for a large literature. Own risk note ('none serious') is accurate.

A reproduction-noise table mined from the literature itself, zero GPUs, immediately usable by every reviewer; citation-provenance tracking (own note) prevents the spread underestimate. The cheapest high-value project in the batch.

The crossing profile (humans below SOTA on convention-diligence, far above on ambiguity and rare objects) would redefine what 'human-level segmentation' means; effort-curve reporting (own note) is the right format. Long overdue.
Dynabench-style adversarial collection is an established methodology; the transfer-validity decomposition is a worthwhile appendix to 0290's shared-blind-spot study rather than a standalone bet.

The ignore-region census with ranking-sensitivity analysis is cheap and untouched; combine with 0194 (behavioral audit of what models emit there) into one exclusion-policy paper - together they clear the bar comfortably.
